privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: SynapseForge ('we', 'us', 'our') is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how we use it.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect information you provide (name, email, company details), usage data (pages visited, features used), and technical data (IP address, browser type) to operate and improve our service.

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use your data to provide the SynapseForge service, communicate with you about your account, improve our platform, and send service-related notifications.

share.title: Data Sharing
share.body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with trusted service providers who help us operate the platform (e.g., cloud hosting, payment processing) under strict data processing agreements.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: We use industry-standard encryption and security practices. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us at hello@synapseforge.ai to exercise these rights.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, contact us at hello@synapseforge.ai.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using SynapseForge ('Service'), you agree to these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.

service.title: Use of Service
service.body: SynapseForge provides managed AI infrastructure services. You may use the Service only in compliance with these terms and applicable laws.

account.title: Account Responsibility
account.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Paid plans are billed monthly or annually. Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. Contact support for billing disputes.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.body: The Service and its content are owned by SynapseForge. You retain ownership of any data you provide.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or engage in harmful activities.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: SynapseForge is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the Service in the past 12 months.
